item_short_desc: Rothco’s Large Mesh Bag is the ideal solution for your laundry and travel needs. Constructed from durable nylon, this lightweight mesh bag offers excellent breathability and sturdiness, making it perfect for storing laundry or carrying travel essentials. The bag features a drawstring top, ensuring secure closure and easy access to your items. With its spacious design measuring 24 inches x 30 inches, the Rothco Large Mesh Bag can accommodate a large volume of clothes or gear.
